item.title: Job #5
item.description:
5th job: Associate Professor at the Department of People and Technology

As Chief Information Officer at Internet Affairs Inc., I lead the strategic transformation of our digital infrastructure and cybersecurity initiatives. My team of 150+ IT professionals works tirelessly to protect and optimize our global network spanning 23 countries.

During my tenure, I’ve spearheaded the implementation of a revolutionary blockchain-based verification system that reduced fraudulent transactions by 87% while improving processing speeds by 300%. This initiative saved the company $12M annually and earned us the prestigious “Digital Innovation Award 2024”.

item.title: Job #2
item.description:
2nd job: IT security intern

During my internship, I spearheaded a much needed assessment of the security practices and established policies for hardware and software solutions for accessibility-impaired citizens.

My main achievement here was to build a bridge between the local IT support and management that resulted in stronger awareness of providing resources for the IT support to better adhere to security best practices.

item.title: IT supporter
item.description:
1st job: Technical supporter for Apple and Macintosh servers and desktops

Beginning as a student helper I managed the backup servers (Retrospect) for the Macintosh computers at our department, ranging about 10 users. I had the opportunity to familiarize myself with the basics of Unix commands and server level hardware and software as well as solving technical troubleshooting tasks such as repairing work stations and arranging and scheduling backups on a weekly basis.
